about: civic.promptugal.news's page views and reads, sent by assets/obs/obs.js (copied from PrompTugal__News__Website on 18 November 2026, at Dinis's word: "add observability to all the other sites") into PrompTugal.news's observability vault, drained by observability@PrompTugal.dinis on account A. The vault, the drain's public key and the shared write-only lanes are read at run time from promptugal.news's own obs.json (config_from), so none is copied here. This site's lane is 'civic': every event says so, and once observability@ issues civic's own append tokens they go in lanes.civic.
what: This site counts page views and reading time, with no IP address kept, no cookie and no user-agent string, as promptugal.news does. Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control and the Pause switch in the footer stop it. What is counted: https://promptugal.news/newsroom/observability/index.html
